name: Sharing the Knowledge
label: Quest
description: Sharing the Knowledge: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: While the recipe for cooking sandworm meat is legible, it contains references to herbs and spices you've never heard of. Calandrath might have enough knowledge of the plants that grow in the desert to make sense of it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you learn the recipe? You won't keep it to yourself, I hope!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Let's have a look at that...
This seems simple enough. They have their own names for some of the herbs, but those are simple enough to figure out. Here, let me show you!
